compute_masked_keypoint_mean: compute the visibility-weighted mean of keypoints using masked_kp_mean with location and visibility tensors
calculate_huber_loss: calculate the Huber loss for squared distances using the huber function with a configurable scaling factor
compute_avg_l2_huber_distance: compute the average L2 Huber distance between two tensors using avg_l2_huber with optional masking support
compute_avg_l2_distance: compute the average L2 distance between two tensors using avg_l2_dist with optional squared and masking support
find_optimal_translation: find the optimal translation vector between two point sets using argmin_translation with optional visibility masking
